A gitoid may represent either an [Artifact Identifier](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-identifier-types) for the software artifact or an [Input Manifest Identifier](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#input-manifest-identifier) for the software artifact's associated [Artifact Input Manifest](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-input-manifest); this ambiguity exists because the Artifact Input Manifest is itself an artifact, and the gitoid of that artifact is its valid identifier. Gitoids calculated on software artifacts (Snippet, File, or Package Elements) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 SoftwareArtifact's contentIdentifier property. Gitoids calculated on the Artifact Input Manifest (Input Manifest Identifier) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 Element's externalIdentifier property. See [OmniBOR Specification](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/), a minimalistic specification for describing software [Artifact Dependency Graphs](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-dependency-graph-adg).

A gitoid may represent either an [Artifact Identifier](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-identifier-types) for the software artifact or an [Input Manifest Identifier](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#input-manifest-identifier) for the software artifact's associated [Artifact Input Manifest](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-input-manifest); this ambiguity exists because the Artifact Input Manifest is itself an artifact, and the gitoid of that artifact is its valid identifier. Gitoids calculated on software artifacts (Snippet, File, or Package Elements) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 SoftwareArtifact's contentIdentifier property. Gitoids calculated on the Artifact Input Manifest (Input Manifest Identifier) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 Element's externalIdentifier property. See [OmniBOR Specification](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/), a minimalistic specification for describing software [Artifact Dependency Graphs](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-dependency-graph-adg).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: vulnerabilityExploitabilityAssessment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a Vulnerability Exploitability eXchange (VEX) statement which provides information on whether a product is impacted by a specific vulnerability in an included package and, if affected, whether there are actions recommended to remediate. See also [NTIA VEX one-page summary](https://ntia.gov/files/ntia/publications/vex_one-page_summary.pdf).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: observation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Documentation of direct monitoring or witnessing of the demonstration of processes, tests, or any kind of system responses during a specified timeframe under specified environmental conditions.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: archive
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is an archived collection of one or more files (.tar, .zip, etc.).
Identifies the full text of a License, in SPDX templating format.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: analyzed
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SBOM generated through analysis of artifacts (e.g., executables, packages, containers, and virtual machine images) after its build. Such analysis generally requires a variety of heuristics. In some contexts, this may also be referred to as a "3rd party" SBOM.
Additional relevance information.
Metric used to evaluate the AI model.
The amount or measure of a bulk product.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.1/terms/Core/DefinedProcess is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: coordinatedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Vulnerability is coordinatedBy the `to` Agent(s) (vendor, researcher, or consumer agent).

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.1/terms/Security/VexVulnAssessmentRelationship is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityAdvisory
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a published security advisory (where advisory as defined per [ISO 29147:2018](https://www.iso.org/standard/72311.html)) that may affect one or more elements, e.g., vendor advisories or specific NVD entries.
The name of the recipient expressed in text.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: fixedIn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A `from` Vulnerability has been fixed in each `to` Element. The use of the `fixedIn` type is constrained to `VexFixedVulnAssessmentRelationship` classed relationships.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: duns
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Data Universal Numbering System (D-U-N-S) Number](https://www.dnb.com/en-us/smb/duns.html) is a unique nine-digit identifier, issued by Dun & Bradstreet, that identifies a business entity, often on a location-specific basis.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: x509Cert
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to an X.509 certificate as defined in [RFC 1422](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc1422/). The media type shall be one of application/x-x509-ca-cert or application/x-x509-user-cert.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: packagedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is a packaged instance of the `from` Element (`from` packagedBy `to`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: packageUrl
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Package URL, as defined in the corresponding [Annex](../../../annexes/pkg-url-specification.md) of this document.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: cpe22
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Common Platform Enumeration Specification 2.2](https://cpe.mitre.org/files/cpe-specification_2.2.pdf).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: socialMedia
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a social media channel for a package.
Expression for the export control classification.
Records any relevant background information or additional comments about the origin of the package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: expandsTo
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element expands out as an artifact described by each `to` Element.
A string in the license expression format.
Title of the project.
Specified the time and date when a vulnerability was withdrawn.
Specifies the time an artifact was released.
Identify the version of a package.
Limitation of the AI software.
Specifies a time when a vulnerability assessment was modified
Anonymization methods used.
The boundary parameters define the area or region needed to describe a boundary.
Energy quantity.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Used when the type does not match any of the other options.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: module
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a module of a piece of software.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityPenTestReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a [penetration test](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Penetration_test) report for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: issueTracker
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the issue tracker for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: vulnerableCodeNotInExecutePath
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The affected code is not reachable through the execution of the code, including non-anticipated states of the product.
A value used in a key-value pair with a generic key that refers to an Element
Information related to virtual hardware simulation.
The intendedUse property is designed to capture a summary of how or for what item or artifact is meant to be used for.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasSpecification
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is a specification for the `from` Element (`from` hasSpecification `to`), during a LifecycleScopeType period.
Protocols which support authentication.
Enumeration of verification types.
Provides information about the primary purpose of an Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: mavenCentral
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a Maven repository artifact. The artifact locator format is defined in the [Maven documentation](https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-naming-conventions.html) and looks like `groupId:artifactId[:version]`.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: patch
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element contains a set of changes to update, fix, or improve another Element.
